Flow: predicting late-adolescent height (Ho 2026, manuscript under review)

Source: R/flow-puberty.R
wgh_flow_height_prediction.Rd

Builds the prediction cohort from prepubertal visits, joins SITAR timing and intensity from wgh_flow_pubertal_spurt() (never size), and benchmarks the M0 to M8 model ladder on identical cross-validation folds, with leave-one-site-out validation, a bootstrap comparison of the primary mixed model with XGBoost, prediction intervals, calibration and Bland-Altman plots, SHAP for XGBoost and an example individual prediction.

Usage

wgh_flow_height_prediction(
  x = NULL,
  mode = NULL,
  spurt = NULL,
  n_children = 30000
)

Arguments

x

Growth data with height, weight and year. When NULL, a simulated wgh_like cohort is generated.

mode

Run mode (see wgh_config()); NULL keeps the current mode.

spurt

Optional report from wgh_flow_pubertal_spurt() on the same data (it is computed when NULL).

n_children

Simulated cohort size when x is NULL. Late adolescent outcomes need long follow-up, so a large cohort is used.

Value

A wgh_report.

Examples

# \donttest{
rep <- wgh_flow_height_prediction(mode = "dev", n_children = 8000)
#> Warning: M6 explains more than 90% of the variance.
#> ℹ SITAR b and c were estimated with visits from the outcome window, so part of
#>   this performance is leakage. Treat M6 as an upper bound.
rep$tables$performance
#> NULL
# }
